summary: C1 Explore review requests changes. Revision 040 resolves the prior terminal-status representation and staging-cleanup findings, but its physical result schema is self-referential: ActionResult requires runRef, while the adapter defines runRef.versionFingerprint as the SHA-256 of the result.json that contains that ActionResult. No stable first-write representation or validation rule is defined.

blockingFindings.title: ResultRef content-hash design is self-referential
blockingFindings.evidence: RunResultFile.actionResult is an ActionResult, whose required runRef includes versionFingerprint. Q7 defines a run-result versionFingerprint as SHA-256 of the complete result.json content. Because result.json contains actionResult.runRef.versionFingerprint, the value to hash is part of the content being hashed; the proposed write path has no stable construction or read-time verification rule for this cycle.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Define a non-self-referential physical serialization boundary. For example, persist an ActionResult payload without its self ResultRef and derive runRef from the finalized file on read, or define and validate a canonical hash projection that excludes the self-reference field. Specify exact write/read behavior and fixtures proving replacement detection and rejection of an incorrect fingerprint.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Resolved by revision 040: RunResultFile explicitly carries terminal runStatus and validates legal executionStatus combinations.
Resolved by revision 040: staging cleanup remains createRun best-effort work and is not assigned to read-only doctor.

checks.name: Formal contract review
checks.result: Reviewed revised Explore against B1 ActionResult/ResultRef types, frozen ResultRef contract, and Q5/Q7 serialization design.
